review.reviewer: operator-selected visual geometry pilot; identity not certified
review.attribution_basis: Operator-selected window and detection indexes; frame-local hands associated by pose-wrist proximity. Multi-person or ambiguous detections are omitted. This is unreviewed geometry and does not verify speaker identity or continuous tracking.

limitations: Geometry estimates do not identify a person or establish emotional state.
Finger segment swing is estimated from selected hand landmarks; axial twist and occluded joints are not recovered.
Detection selection and speaker attribution are reviewer assertions, not biometric verification.
The reference frame establishes a rotation reference, not an automatically detected anatomical neutral face.
Pose landmarks outside the image or below visibility/presence 0.65 are omitted.
Limb and finger rotations use direction-only swing; axial twist is not recovered.
Rotations are bounded to 70 degrees relative to the reference pose.
Unobserved channels, gaps, and channels unavailable in the reference frame stay absent.
